title: Trevor Philips
text:
'''Trevor Philips''' is one of the three [[protagonist]]s (along with [[Michael De Santa]] and [[Franklin Clinton]]) of , and a major character in . 

Trevor is a career criminal and former bank robber with a troubled past and raging abandonment issues. After founding his own company, [[Trevor Philips Enterprises]], he seeks to expand his control over the illegal gun and drug trade in [[Blaine County]], [[State of San Andreas (HD Universe)|San Andreas]]. Upon learning of his former friend and partner-in-crime Michael's survival, Trevor, having presumed Michael to be dead for a decade, finds him and resumes their old partnership, but soon discovers troubling secrets about their shared past that lead him to question his loyalties.

title: Trevor Philips
text:
Following the events of ''Grand Theft Auto V'', Trevor is referenced in content updates for ''Grand Theft Auto Online'' taking place after the single-player story. These confirm that Trevor has retired his company and left Blaine County for new pastures, but his current whereabouts remain unknown.

He is portrayed by [[Steven Ogg]].

title: Trevor Philips
text:
What is known about Trevor's background is highly speculative and comes from his own words. Trevor was born and raised in [[Canada]], near the border with the [[United States]], or, as he calls it, the "Canadian border region of America". He claims he "grew up in five states, two countries", in "fourteen different homes", "three care homes", "two correctional facilities", with "eight fathers", and "one beautiful, damaged flower of a [[Mrs. Philips|mother]]."9232|Video}})}}}}

As a child, Trevor had a history of rage issues and violent impulses that ruined any chances of fitting into society. He claims that, in a fit of rage, he sodomized his hockey coach with a [[Hockey Stick|hockey stick]]}}, and at some point he supposedly strangled a clarinet player with his own instrument. Trevor also claims to have killed various [[animals]] and "drifters" even during the early years of his life.}}

title: Trevor Philips
text: Trevor's childhood itself was an unhappy one. His father was physically abusive towards him,}} while his mother was emotionally abusive, overbearing, treated him with condescension and saw him as a "useless boy" who cared little about her. <!--While not confirmed, it is implied that, due the fact that Trevor hates to be called a "motherfucker" with this triggering two of his [[Rampages|rampage missions]] and what caused him to kill [[Johnny Klebitz]], his mother might have also been sexually abusive towards him as well.--> When he was a child, Trevor's father abandoned him in a shopping mall, which Trevor claims to have later burned down in retaliation. Trevor also had a brother named [[Ryan Philips|Ryan]], whom Trevor was not fond of. Ryan died in an "accident" prior to [[2013]].

title: Trevor Philips
text:
Trevor dropped out of school, ultimately robbing him of some grammatical skills and basic knowledge, such as the location of ancient Rome, which he believed to be part of America. It is possible, however, that he had some formal education, as he claims — though possibly sarcastically — that he took a night class in criminal law. Despite this, he does have good mathematical skills, such as being able to accurately calculate the price of four tons of gold in a matter of seconds. Trevor also claims that he was the Canadian under-18 Golf Champion and "nearly went pro". 

Later in his life, Trevor discovered that he had a talent for flying jets. He enlisted in the air force to fly fighter jets, but several days prior to completing his training and becoming a licensed pilot, Trevor was deemed mentally unstable during a psychological evaluation, thus resulting in his discharge and grounding for life. It is implied his discharge was due to his psychological relationship with his mother.

title: Trevor Philips
text: After leaving the military, Trevor became a drifter and committed petty crimes along the border with no particular goal in mind.}} In the late 1980s or early '90s, around the age of 20, he eventually began running a small air freight operation in [[North Yankton]]}}, where he met his future partner-in-crime, [[Michael De Santa|Michael Townley]].7685|a friend activity}}.}} While waiting on the runway to meet his employer, he saw not one but two dust trails coming up the road, despite the fact that he was told there would be only one person meeting him. Michael exited the first car while an older man whom Michael previously carjacked exited the other, yelling at them. Trevor shot off a flare gun he was carrying into the older man's eye, killing him. He and Michael both dumped the body into a lake afterwards. The flare was still burning from the inside of his head, causing the pair to throw up. After the incident, Trevor and Michael became friends and started a criminal partnership together.}}}}

title: Trevor Philips
text: Trevor's first job involved robbing a place that cashed checks. However, he was caught because the clerk turned out to be someone who knew him, resulting in him serving four months of a six-month sentence. After Trevor was released, he and Michael committed many robberies all over the , though Michael's recognizable quoting of lines from [[Solomon Richards]]'s movies, and Trevor's habit to snap and murder people in broad daylight often kept them on the run. Throughout their crime spree, they worked with several [[Moses|other]] accomplices; the closest one being [[Lester Crest]] a talented hacker and heist planner.

title: Trevor Philips
text: Over time, Michael developed a relationship with and married a stripper named [[Amanda De Santa|Amanda]], eventually having two kids, [[Tracey De Santa|Tracey]] and [[Jimmy De Santa|Jimmy]]. This created some friction between the criminals, due to Michael spending more and more time with his new family and less with his criminal activities. Despite this, Trevor began to see himself as an uncle to the couple's children, even vowing to avenge Tracey should anyone 'wrong her'. Over the following years, Michael became more cautious as a criminal because he saw himself having more to lose should he be imprisoned or killed, which led Trevor to believe Michael was going "soft". As a result, Trevor recruited a fellow crook named [[Brad Snider]] to take part in their robberies. Michael and Lester distrusted Brad, never showing any empathy towards him. At some point, Brad suggested to Trevor that they cut off Michael and work only with each other. Trevor refused, believing he should stay loyal to Michael.

title: Trevor Philips
text:
[[File:Prologue-GTA5.jpg|thumb|280px|left|The last time '''Trevor''' would see Michael for nine years.]]

Trevor and Michael remained partners in crime until they undertook an [[Prologue (GTA V)|ill-fated heist in 2004]] alongside Brad and a [[Getaway Driver|getaway driver]] in [[Ludendorff]], North Yankton. Secretly, Michael made an agreement with corrupt [[Federal Investigation Bureau|FIB]] agent [[Dave Norton]] to exit his life of crime and start over with his family in [[Los Santos (HD Universe)|Los Santos]]. The plan involved the group robbing a [[Bobcat Security Depot|cash depot]], followed by them making their way to a rendezvous point, where Dave would fatally shoot Trevor and non-fatally shoot Michael, with the latter then pretending to be buried at the [[Ludendorff Church and Cemetery|Ludendorff Cemetery]], before actually moving to [[Los Santos (HD Universe)|Los Santos]] with his family.

title: Trevor Philips
text: The heist initially ran relatively smoothly until [[Alex (GTA V)|two]] [[Jaspers|security guards]] were killed the second one by Trevor as the guard held Michael at gunpoint and the [[North Yankton State Patrol|police]] arrived, which the group had to fight through, barely managing to get to their [[Rancher XL (snowed)|getaway car]]. As they drove to the rendezvous point, where they were told a helicopter was waiting for them, their driver was killed by the police and Michael was forced to take the wheel, though their vehicle was struck by an oncoming [[Freight Train|train]] at a railroad crossing and destroyed. Michael insisted that they stick to the plan, and they began walking in search of the helicopter. They were then ambushed by Dave, who fired at the trio, missing Trevor and fatally wounding Brad instead, before shooting again and "injuring" Michael. Trevor refused to leave his friends behind and attempted to fight off the police until a weary Michael told him to save himself, prompting Trevor to reluctantly make his escape.

title: Trevor Philips
text: As a result of the failed heist, both Trevor and Michael wrongly believed one another to be dead. Trevor was not able to get access to his savings because of his identity being blown, but regardless managed to evade the police for several years and made a new life for himself in the rural town of [[Sandy Shores]], [[State of San Andreas (HD Universe)|San Andreas]]. There, he developed an addiction to crystal [[Methamphetamine|meth]] and founded a small criminal business with new-found partners [[Ron Jakowski]], a paranoiac conspiracy theorist, and [[Chef]], a meth cook. The business, named [[Trevor Philips Enterprises]] (alternatively called Trevor Philips Industries), specialized in arms smuggling and the cooking and sale of crystal methamphetamine. During Trevor's time in Sandy Shores, he affiliated himself with the [[Varrios Los Aztecas (HD Universe)|Aztecas]] gang, the redneck hillbilly [[O'Neil Brothers]], and high-ranked members of [[The Lost MC]] including the club's leader, [[Johnny Klebitz]]. However, the latter's relationship was particularly strained due to Trevor's tendency to occasionally have sex with Johnny's girlfriend, [[Ashley Butler]], in exchange for meth payments, much to Johnny's chagrin.

title: Trevor Philips
text:
Trevor, unaware that Brad had succumbed to his injuries, incorrectly believed he had been incarcerated as a result of the failed Ludendorff heist, and sent a letter to the federal prison system addressed to him. However, the letter was intercepted by the FIB, who established a correspondence to monitor him. The responses Trevor received from "Brad" were actually written by FIB trainees under the direction of Dave Norton.

In [[2012]], [[Fooliganz]] [[Wade Hebert]], [[Daisy Bell]], [[Kush-Chronic]], and several others stopped in Sandy Shores to buy drugs while on their way to "the gathering". They met Trevor, who took the group, save Wade, to a nearby [[Davis Quartz|quarry]] and is implied to have murdered them. Wade never figured out what happened to his friends and decided to stay in Sandy Shores, joining Trevor's criminal empire. At some point, Trevor rammed a hockey stick up Wade's anus, just like he had done before to his hockey coach.

title: Trevor Philips
text:
[[File:TrevorPhilips-GTAOe-Introduction.png|thumb|right|280px|'''Trevor''' meets the ''GTA Online'' Protagonist after they stole his RV, which he used as a meth lab.]]

In [[2013]], a few months prior to the events of ''Grand Theft Auto V'', Ron contacts the , who has been ruining the businesses of Trevor and other drug dealers, [[Meth'd Up|specifically after stealing an RV full of meth]] belonging to Trevor for a member of [[The Families]] named [[Gerald]]. The player meets Trevor at his [[Trevor's Trailer|trailer]] in Sandy Shores and they settle their issues by agreeing to have the player do jobs for Trevor Philips Industries, which mainly consist of stealing drugs from rival groups, such as The Lost MC, and killing the dealers.

Additionally, Trevor would also occasionally call the ''GTA Online'' Protagonist to [[Plane Takedown|take down rival planes]].

title: Trevor Philips
text:
[[File:TrevorPhilipsEnterprises-GTAO.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Trevor planning the [[Series A]] heist with Ron, Chef and the ''GTA Online'' Protagonist.]]

Eventually, Trevor plans a heist and recruits the ''GTA Online'' Protagonist and several associates to [[Series A|take part]]. He tasks them with stealing drugs from several groups, such as the [[Los Santos Vagos (HD Universe)|Vagos]], The Lost MC, and the [[Ballas (HD Universe)|Ballas]], in order to sell them himself.

title: Trevor Philips
text: After the crew successfully takes the drugs, Trevor is at a warehouse, [[Series A Funding|ready to move the product]], but is informed that the gangs they robbed are coming back for their goods. After Trevor and the crew hold off the gangs, they rush to the [[El Gordo Lighthouse]], where the drug deal is set to take place. Trevor then gives the crew their money in advance and they leave. He stays at the lighthouse and waits for [[Phil (DOA Agent)|the buyer]] to arrive, but when he shows up, Trevor correctly determines that he is an undercover agent, and that the deal is a sting operation by the [[Drug Observation Agency]]. Trevor escapes by jumping off of a cliff into the ocean and swimming to safety. Later on, he angrily smashes his head against a tree before crying uncontrollably.

title: Trevor Philips
text: [[File:Trevor&Johnny-GTA5.jpg|thumb|right|280px|'''Trevor''' "consoling" Johnny.]]

title: Trevor Philips
text: While having sex with Ashley, Trevor's attention is caught by a news report about the [[The Jewel Store Job|robbery]] of a [[Vangelico|jewelry store]] in [[Los Santos (HD Universe)|Los Santos]], during which a [[Albert Stalley|witness]] claims one of the robbers quoted a movie phrase that was a favorite of Michael Townley's. Stunned, Trevor grabs a beer and walks out his trailer to process it, only to be confronted by Johnny for having sex with Ashley again. While trying to avoid a confrontation by simply walking away, he is pushed to his breaking-point as Johnny continues to express his anger. Trevor, no longer able to ignore Johnny's rage, mockingly invites him to have sex, and starts making jokes about his meth addiction, claiming that it is the reason for the friction between the two men. Johnny lays his guard down and tells Trevor that he still loves Ashley, to which Trevor responds by hugging and "consoling" him before he finally snaps. He suddenly grabs the biker by the neck and throws him to the ground, where he proceeds to smash his beer bottle against Johnny's face and stomp repeatedly on his head, killing Johnny as Wade, Ron, and Ashley watch in horror.

title: Trevor Philips
text: Knowing that Johnny's gang will be outraged over their leader's callous murder, Trevor decides to preemptively [[Mr. Philips|wipe out]] The Lost MC and their meth business from Blaine County before they have a chance to exact revenge. He drives with Wade and Ron to a Lost [[R L Hunter & Sons|hangout]] in [[Grapeseed]] where [[Terry Thorpe]], [[Clay Simons]], and several other members of the Lost are. While driving, he has the option to run over Ashley as she cries over Johnny's body. After announcing and mocking Johnny's death, the members of The Lost retreat to [[The Range|their main hideout]], to notify the rest of the gang. Trevor aggressively follows them there in his [[Bodhi|Canis Bodhi]], with Ron and Wade tagging along. As he chases the bikers, Trevor can optionally kill Terry and Clay by shooting or running them off their bikes.

title: Trevor Philips
text: When they arrive, Trevor, alongside Ron and Wade, attacks the hideout and wipes out a number of Lost members. Afterwards, he orders Wade to find out where Michael Townley lives. In the meantime, Trevor and Ron do more work, including attacking the trailer of [[Varrios Los Aztecas (HD Universe)|Aztecas]] leader [[Ortega]], along with optionally killing him, and [[Nervous Ron|taking over]] an [[Sandy Shores Airfield|airfield]] run by The Lost MC, after they vandalize Trevor's trailer as revenge for him killing Johnny.

title: Trevor Philips
text:
[[File:CrystalMaze-GTA5.png|thumb|280px|left|'''Trevor''' preparing to assault the O'Neils.]]
Trevor attempts to do business with the [[Los Santos Triads]], led by a man known as [[Wei Cheng]], who wants a reliable partner to help expand his business operations in Blaine County. Wei sends his son, [[Tao Cheng]], along with a [[Tao Cheng's Translator|translator]] to meet with Trevor, who attempts to show them [[Ace Liquor|his meth lab]]. During the tour, he is forced to hide the translator and Tao in a freezer when members of the Aztecas attack, resulting in a [[Trevor Philips Industries|shootout]], which Trevor emerges victorious from. Ultimately, however, the Triads cancel the potential deal with Trevor and choose to do business with the rival [[O'Neil Brothers]] gang instead.

title: Trevor Philips
text: Enraged after learning this, Trevor decides to kill the O'Neils. On the way to their ranch, Trevor receives a phone call from [[Elwood O'Neil]] who invites Trevor to talk so they can smooth the issue over, but Trevor declines the offer and lets Elwood know what he plans to do. A panicked Elwood tells his brothers and associates to protect the farm before leaving with two of his other brothers, [[Walton O'Neil|Walton]] and [[Wynn O'Neil|Wynn]], to meet with the Triads. Despite the O'Neils' efforts, Trevor [[Crystal Maze|attacks]] the [[O'Neil Ranch]], slaughtering the brothers and obliterating their farm by lighting a gas trail he made using a [[Jerry Can]] from their basement meth lab.

title: Trevor Philips
text: A short while later, Trevor receives news from Wade that two people named Michael Townley live in Los Santos, but neither match Trevor's description, as one is an old man and the [[Michael Townley (kindergartner)|other]] is in kindergarten. However, Wade claims that a man who matches Michael Townley's profile named "Michael De Santa" lives in Los Santos, has two children and is married to a woman named Amanda. Trevor recognizes his old partner's alias and decides to take a [[Friends Reunited|trip]] to the city with Wade. Before leaving, he briefly visits The Lost MC's main hideout as a new chapter was recommissioned there to continue business. He destroys their camp entirely with [[Sticky Bombs]], further removing the group's presence from Sandy Shores. Afterwards, he arrives in the city and locates an [[Floyd's Apartment|apartment]] where Wade's cousin [[Floyd Hebert|Floyd]] lives, deciding to stay there, despite Floyd's protests.

title: Trevor Philips
text:
[[File:TrevorPhilips-GTA5-Yoga.jpg|thumb|280px|right|'''Trevor''' surprising everyone with his sudden appearance.]]
Trevor then tracks down Michael to his [[De Santa Residence|home]] in the affluent district of [[Rockford Hills]], surprising and shocking everyone in the house, who all believed Michael's word that Trevor was likely dead. When Trevor asks where [[Tracey De Santa|Tracey]] is, [[Jimmy De Santa|Jimmy]] reveals that she is auditioning for ''[[Fame or Shame]]''. Trevor and Michael rush to the [[Maze Bank Arena]], knowing well that Tracey will humiliate herself with her terrible dancing on TV. The two disrupt the audition, where Tracey is just as surprised as the rest of her family to see Trevor. When the presenter of the show, [[Lazlow Jones (HD Universe)|Lazlow Jones]], begins to make sexual advances towards Tracey during her dance, Trevor and Michael become angry and [[Fame or Shame (mission)|chase]] Lazlow to the [[Los Santos River (HD Universe)|Los Santos River]], where Trevor humiliates the reality TV star by making him take off his pants and dance while he films it on his mobile phone, before leaving.

title: Trevor Philips
text: After learning that Floyd works at the [[Port of Los Santos]], Trevor, along with Wade, forcibly accompanies him to his job, disguised as dock workers to [[Scouting the Port|see if anything worth stealing is present]]. While they are there, Trevor learns that a private security force named [[Merryweather Security|Merryweather]] has a [[SS Bulker|freighter ship]] containing secret cargo. Assuming the object is valuable, he plans a heist to steal the cargo for himself with the help of Michael, whom Trevor feels "owes him one".

title: Trevor Philips
text: Before the planned robbery can go underway, however, Trevor, along with Michael, are contacted by a highly-decorated yet highly-corrupt [[Federal Investigation Bureau|FIB agent]] named [[Steve Haines]] for assistance in [[Three's Company|extracting]] an [[Azerbaijan|Azerbaijani]] prisoner named [[Ferdinand Kerimov]], who is being held by the [[International Affairs Agency|IAA]] at their [[IAA Headquarters|headquarters]]. Before the operation is underway, Michael introduces Trevor to his recently antiquated friend, a Families gang member named [[Franklin Clinton]]. Trevor assists in the operation by flying the [[Frogger|helicopter]] used to allow Michael to extract the prisoner from the building, which he promptly keeps for himself afterwards 'in lieu of payment'.

title: Trevor Philips
text:
[[File:TrevorPhilips-GTA5-SS1.jpg|thumb|280px|left|'''Trevor''' demanding to taste the other side of the brick.]]
Trevor later visits Franklin in [[Strawberry|his neighborhood]], telling him and his friend [[Lamar Davis|Lamar]] that he is looking to make "friends". He accompanies the pair on a minor drug deal at [[Grove Street (HD Universe)|Grove Street]] set up by a fellow gang member named [[Stretch (character)|Stretch]], much to Lamar's annoyance. The deal initially goes smoothly, until Trevor grows suspicious and attempts to take a sample of the [[cocaine]] brick they were going to purchase. He snaps the brick in half, revealing a key inside and that it was actually a piece of drywall. A [[Hood Safari|gunfight]] breaks out, and the three have to fight through a group of oncoming rival Ballas gang members. The [[Los Santos Police Department (HD Universe)|LSPD]] arrive, so Lamar leads Franklin and Trevor down into the Los Santos River. Hijacking [[Speedophile|jet skis]] from a [[MC Clip|rapper's]] professional photo shoot, the trio escape via the river from the oncoming police.

title: Trevor Philips
text: Trevor is brought back to work for the FIB once more, this time to [[By the Book|interrogate]] Kerimov, the man he helped to rescue from the IAA. Trevor extracts information out of Kerimov by torturing him, while Haines observes and asks the questions, before relaying the answers to Michael and Dave Norton, who are supposed to find and assassinate alleged Azerbaijani terrorist [[Tahir Javan]]. After the job is done, Haines orders Trevor to kill Kerimov and dispose of his body before leaving. Instead of following Haines' orders, Trevor helps Kerimov escape by driving him to the [[Los Santos International Airport (HD Universe)|Los Santos airport]] and telling him to run away in order to become an advocate against government-sanctioned torture, despite the fact that Kerimov lives in Los Santos, has American citizenship, and has family living there as well.

title: Trevor Philips
text:
Eventually, Trevor gets to put his [[The Merryweather Heist|heist]] into motion and manages to steal the target cargo with the help of Michael and Franklin. However, Michael and Trevor's old contact whom the former had recently been working with again, Lester Crest, arrives to discourage Trevor from taking the cargo, as it is in fact a superweapon that the U.S. government were planning to trade to the Chinese and will stop at nothing to recover it, especially if it is in the hands of a person like Trevor. Trevor initially refuses to give it up, but is forced to do so when Michael and Franklin agree it is not worth keeping due to its dangerous nature.

Following the heist, Trevor receives a call from [[Elwood O'Neil]], who threatens to kill Trevor for murdering his brothers and destroying the O'Neil family ranch in Sandy Shores. Trevor ignores the threat and invites Elwood and what remains of his family to come and find him in Los Santos before hanging up the call.

title: Trevor Philips
text:
[[File:TrevorPhilips-GTA5-Paleto.jpg|thumb|280px|right|'''Trevor''', Michael and Chef in [[The Paleto Score]].]]
Getting over the failed heist, Trevor continues to do jobs with Michael and Franklin, including [[Blitz Play|stealing]] money from an [[Securicar|armored car]] and [[I Fought the Law...|helping]] [[Eye in the Sky|to]] procure luxury vehicles for a billionaire named [[Devin Weston]], the latter of which [[Pack Man|they are not paid for]], greatly enraging them. Eventually, Trevor takes a job with Michael that involves [[Caida Libre|assassinating]] the [[Javier Madrazo|cousin]] of [[Mexico|Mexican]] drug lord [[Martin Madrazo]], for planning to testify against him in a court case. Trevor is under the assumption that Michael brought him on to help case Madrazo's [[La Fuente Blanca|house]], but when he mentions this, Michael clarifies they are not going to rob Madrazo, annoying Trevor. After Michael shoots down the [[Shamal|plane]] that Madrazo's cousin was flying on, Trevor finds the crash site and kills the cousin, who survived the crash, then recovers the testimony. As Trevor drops it off at Madrazo's ranch, payment negotiations fall through and he witnesses Madrazo mistreating his wife, [[Patricia Madrazo|Patricia]]. Trevor, having developed an infatuation with her and already being in a poor mood over not getting to rob Madrazo, severs one of his ears and kidnaps Patricia, forcing himself and Michael to go into hiding at the former's trailer. During this time, the pair are unable to enter Los Santos without being attacked by Madrazo's men.

title: Trevor Philips
text: Whilst in hiding, Trevor continues [[Minor Turbulence|trying]] to run his business, [[Predator (mission)|kills]] what's left of the O'Neils with Michael and Franklin, and [[The Paleto Score|helps rob a bank]] in [[Paleto Bay]] in order to secure funding for [[Monkey Business|another FIB job]], which then requires him to help Michael and Dave Norton escape the [[Humane Labs and Research]] facility as they try to steal a neurotoxic chemical being developed there. Eventually, Michael repays Madrazo with [[Derailed|an artifact he and Trevor steal]] from a Merryweather train, while a reluctant Trevor returns Patricia to her husband, whom he threatens with further violence should he ever mistreat his wife again. With his problems with Madrazo now taken care of, Trevor and Michael are once again able to safely enter Los Santos.

title: Trevor Philips
text: Upon Trevor's return to Floyd's apartment, he encounters Floyd's girlfriend [[Debra]], who has returned home from a business trip overseas. Debra quickly becomes annoyed with Trevor's presence, demanding that he leave. Trevor drives Debra to her limits after suggesting that she caught crabs at the conference she attended and that they were "regular little fuck fests", and eventually breaks down crying and makes a mocking proposal to marry Debra and Floyd. An enraged Debra brandishes a gun at Trevor, and Floyd picks up a nearby knife after mustering some courage, to which Trevor tells them that they "are not very fucking nice". In the ensuing chaos, Floyd is shot in the head and Debra is stabbed to death. After leaving the apartment, a blood-stained Trevor encounters Wade, who asks where Floyd is. Trevor lies to him and says that Debra and Floyd mysteriously "[[Hang Ten|disappeared]]" and probably won't come back. Wade and Trevor then move into the [[Vanilla Unicorn]] strip club after "taking it over" by murdering the [[Leon (GTA V)|previous manager]]. There, he meets with Michael, Franklin, and Lester to plan the robbery of the [[Union Depository]]. In order to do so, they [[Surveying the Score|survey]] the depository for any possible escape routes. Michael and Franklin observe by car, while Trevor and Lester observe by helicopter.

title: Trevor Philips
text:
[[File:TrevorPhilips-GTA5-SS2.jpg|thumb|280px|left|'''Trevor''' digging up Michael's grave to confirm his suspicions.]]
After meeting up with Michael at his mansion, Trevor tries to convince Michael that they bust Brad out of prison and start robbing banks like they used to do years ago. Michael refuses, however, due to the fact that he has a family and wants to make movies, which irritates Trevor. Because of Michael's reluctance to talk about Brad and Trevor's suspicions about what actually happened in North Yankton and who was really buried in Michael's grave, Trevor deduces that Michael betrayed him and flies back to North Yankton, with Michael in pursuit. Trevor arrives first at the graveyard and exhumes Michael Townley's grave. His suspicions are confirmed when he finds Brad's decaying corpse in Michael's place. After a stand-off at the grave, during which Michael somewhat explains the deal that took place between him and Dave Norton, Trevor, feeling hurt and betrayed by Michael's revelation, flees when the duo is [[Bury the Hatchet|ambushed]] by Wei Cheng's Triads, who had followed Michael from the airport, hoping that he would lead them to Trevor.

title: Trevor Philips
text: As Trevor flies back to San Andreas, he receives a phone call from Wei Cheng who threatens Trevor, claiming that he kidnapped Michael and that he will kill him if he does not surrender his business in Sandy Shores, mistaking Michael as Trevor's gay lover due to the fact that they lived together in his trailer for the period of time while Madrazo was after them. Trevor ignores the threat due to his newly ignited feud with Michael and tells Cheng to do as he pleases.

title: Trevor Philips
text: Much later, Trevor meets up with Franklin at his [[Clinton Residence|aunt's house]] in [[Strawberry]]. When Franklin asks him about Michael's whereabouts, Trevor becomes agitated as he reluctantly tells Franklin that Michael was kidnapped by the Triads before punching a nearby pedestrian and leaving, requiring Franklin to [[Fresh Meat (mission)|rescue]] Michael. At some point afterwards, Trevor wakes up drunk on a small island off the coast of the [[Palomino Highlands]], surrounded by the bodies of Lost MC members, presumably having been killed by Trevor.

title: Trevor Philips
text:
[[File:TrevorPhilips-GTA5-SS3.jpg|thumb|280px|right|'''Trevor''' helping Michael during the Kortz Center shootout.]]
Although he now considers Michael to be his enemy, Trevor, aware that he and Michael need each other to [[The Big Score (GTA V)|pull off the Union Depository heist that they've dreaming about for ages]], and refusing to allow anyone but himself to kill Michael, comes to assist Michael and Dave Norton when they are [[The Wrap Up|ambushed]] by the FIB, IAA, and Merryweather at the [[Kortz Center]]. After helping deal with [[Lamar Down|an incident where Lamar is set up by Stretch to be captured]] by the Ballas, the Union Depository heist is carried out successfully, as Trevor and the crew manage to escape with tons of gold worth millions.

title: Trevor Philips
text:
After the heist, Franklin is given separate orders by Steve Haines and Devin Weston to kill one of his friends. Haines wants him to [[Something Sensible|kill Trevor]] due to his unpredictable nature making Trevor a liability, while Weston wants him to [[The Time's Come|kill Michael]] as revenge for [[Legal Trouble|the death of his lawyer]] and [[Meltdown (GTA V)|subsequent failure to murder Michael's family]], both incidents that Weston blames Michael for. Franklin must choose to kill Michael, kill Trevor, or [[The Third Way|save them and team up with them both to kill all of their enemies]].

<tabber>
Option C=

title: Trevor Philips
text: Franklin contacts Lester and asks him for help on figuring out what to do. Although initially suggesting that Franklin kill both Michael and Trevor, Lester devises a plan to get rid of their enemies once and for all, by luring Haines' corrupt FIB allies and Weston's private Merryweather battalion to a foundry where the three protagonists plan to ambush and kill all of them, stripping both Haines and Weston of their brute force power.

title: Trevor Philips
text: Trevor helps Franklin, Michael, and Lamar fight off Merryweather and the FIB. After killing all of them, Franklin, Michael, and Trevor discuss killing their enemies. Michael suggests killing Steve Haines, while Trevor suggests killing Dave Norton, a proposal rejected by Michael because they need him alive so that he can clear their names. Trevor then suggests killing Stretch and Franklin suggests killing Wei Cheng. After their discussion, they call Lester to track down their targets. Franklin goes after Wei, Michael goes after Stretch, and Trevor goes after Steve.

title: Trevor Philips
text:
After killing Steve at [[Del Perro Pier]], Trevor goes after Devin Weston at his [[Buen Vino Road Mansion|mansion]]. Once Trevor has killed all of his guards, he kidnaps Devin and locks him in the trunk of his own [[Tornado|car]], before taking him to the foothills of [[Mount Chiliad (HD Universe)|Mount Chiliad]]. En route, Devin attempts to appease Trevor, offering him all he's ever wanted (a place of work for him and investment stocks for his corporation), but Trevor responds that all he's ever wanted is for Devin to drift in and out of consciousness as he is slowly disemboweled, and that he is 'gold rich' from the Union Depository heist, so Devin's efforts are futile and the tycoon flies into absolute rage and hysteria. When Michael and Franklin meet up with him, they gloat and taunt Devin over his defeat and their victory against him, followed by the three protagonists pushing Devin's car, with Devin locked inside the trunk, over the cliff's edge and into the sea, where the car promptly explodes, killing Devin. Following this, the trio goes their separate ways but agree to remain friends.
|-|
Option A=

title: Trevor Philips
text:
Franklin and Trevor meet at the [[Murrieta Oil Field|Murrieta Oilfields]] where the former pulls a gun on the latter, claiming that he likes him but he's going to get them all killed in the end. Trevor flees in his truck with Franklin in hot pursuit, escalating into a full-speed chase around the fields. Eventually, Michael crashes into Trevor's truck, causing him to crash into a gas tanker, covering him in gasoline.

As an injured Trevor climbs out of his car, he realizes that Michael and Franklin have teamed up to kill him, declaring them both "Judases" and offering them the opportunity to shoot him, having lost the will to live upon learning that two of his closest friends had turned on him. Either Franklin or Michael shoots the gas, which incinerates Trevor before the tanker explodes. Afterwards, Franklin and Michael will frequently reassure themselves and others who ask that Trevor was a dangerous maniac and that taking him out was the right choice.

|-|
Option B=

title: Trevor Philips
text:
Franklin calls Trevor and asks for his help with killing Michael, but Trevor refuses, saying that he is "done with traitors" and telling Franklin they "deserve each other". After Franklin kills Michael, Trevor emails Franklin asking if it was him who did it, which Franklin denies. Trevor, however, does not believe him and cuts off all ties, telling him that Franklin is dead to him. If the pair meet in the street, he will accuse Franklin of being a snake and warns him to stay away. When Jimmy calls him, Trevor isn't sure what to say as he was never close to his own father, but that he sends his best to Amanda.

</tabber>

title: Trevor Philips
text:
[[File:SmugglersRun-GTAO-PurchasingHangar-RonMentionsTrevor.ogg|center|noicon]]

As mentioned by [[Ron Jakowski]] during the [[Cutscenes|cutscene]] after purchasing the [[Hangars|Hangar]] in the [[GTA Online: Smuggler's Run|Smuggler's Run]] update, set in [[2017]], Trevor has "gone [[Vinewood (HD Universe)|Vinewood]]" and became a "guru" and a "lifestyle coach". It is unclear if Trevor has exited the drug trade entirely, but Ron refers to Trevor as his "old boss", indicating that Ron no longer works under Trevor. This was the first confirmation that [[Something Sensible]] is not the [[canon]]ical ending in ''Grand Theft Auto V''.

title: Trevor Philips
text: Later, Trevor is briefly referenced, though not by name, during the events of [[GTA Online: The Diamond Casino & Resort|The Diamond Casino & Resort]] update, set in [[2019]]. During the [[Casino Story Missions|Casino Story]] mission [[Casino - Loose Cheng]], [[Agatha Baker]] tells the ''GTA Online'' Protagonist that [[Tao Cheng]] went to Sandy Shores to purchase crystal meth from a dealer he had previously met around there (referencing the business deal between Trevor and the Triads during the mission [[Trevor Philips Industries]] in ''Grand Theft Auto V''), although the dealer was nowhere to be found and Tao got kidnapped by [[The Lost MC]]. Later, in the mission [[Casino - Strong Arm Tactics]], when driving Tao and his translator to the [[Pacific Bluffs Country Club]] to meet up with Agatha, Tao says "I almost got killed at this country club once already. Never again", referencing the events of [[The Third Way]] mission in ''Grand Theft Auto V'', and confirming it as the canonical ending in ''GTA V''.

title: Trevor Philips
text:
In [[GTA Online: The Diamond Casino Heist|The Diamond Casino Heist]] update, Jimmy De Santa is employed in the protagonist's [[Arcade]]. When the player is idle around him, he calls Lester the "weirdest uncle in history", before correcting himself saying "second weirdest", implying Trevor is still close with the De Santas as of 2019.

While not directly mentioned or present, Trevor makes another appearance in [[GTA Online: The Cayo Perico Heist|The Cayo Perico Heist]] update via a salacious picture included in the [[Madrazo Files]], during the finale cutscene of the first playthrough (set in [[2020]]) of [[The Cayo Perico Heist]], alongside Patricia Madrazo, confirming that they did have an affair together.

title: Trevor Philips
text: Although Trevor is not seen during the events of the [[GTA Online: Los Santos Tuners|Los Santos Tuners]] update, [[Moodymann|KDJ]] states during [[The Lost Contract/Finale|The Lost Contract]] that Chef works with "a real psycho crew", possibly referring to the remaining members of Trevor Philips Enterprises, or a possible foreshadowing of the [[Fooliganz]], who both Chef and Ron are seen to have connections with.

title: Trevor Philips
text: In [[2021]], Trevor is once again mentioned in [[GTA Online: The Contract|The Contract]] by [[F. Clinton and Partner]]'s [[Agency Security Guard|security guard]], stating that a "crazy dude" dressed like a "hobo" barged into [[Franklin Clinton|Franklin's]] office and claimed that he and Franklin used to work together. After the security guard told him that Franklin wasn't available, he tried to defecate on the office desk. He is also mentioned by Franklin himself, after [[Imani]] tracked down the ''GTA Online'' Protagonist's background and informed Franklin that they used to work with Trevor in 2013. During the stolen watch variation of [[Security Contract: Recover Valuables]], it is revealed that the Vanilla Unicorn club has been taken over by the [[Armenian Mob]], meaning Trevor no longer maintains ownership of it.

title: Trevor Philips
text: By [[2022]], during the events of [[GTA Online: The Criminal Enterprises|The Criminal Enterprises]] and [[GTA Online: Los Santos Drug Wars|Los Santos Drug Wars]] updates, it is revealed that most of Trevor's businesses are now abandoned, including the [[TPI Meth Lab]]. The [[Fooliganz]] gang took over Trevor's disused meth lab at [[Ace Liquor]] and the [[TPI Warehouse]] for themselves, the latter being turned into [[The Freakshop]]. Ron also mentions that Trevor no longer lives in Sandy Shores by this time, having left after receiving his take from the [[Union Depository]] heist and having access to his pre-Ludendorff savings restored, which could mean that Trevor Philips Enterprises is defunct by this time.

title: Trevor Philips
text:
Trevor's former home appears to be haunted by the ghost of [[Johnny Klebitz]], which was caught on camera as evidence for paranormal activity during a [[Ghosts Exposed|public photography competition]] in [[2023]] for a documentary series about paranormal activity in Blaine County created by the [[Ghosts Exposed (business)|Ghosts Exposed]] documentary crew.

In early [[2025]], as part of the [[GTA Online: Agents of Sabotage|Agents of Sabotage]] update, Ron sends the ''GTA Online'' Protagonist a text message informing them that the [[McKenzie Field Hangar]] that Trevor used to own is going to be put up for sale soon by [[Maze Bank Foreclosures]] and that he never really trusted [[Oscar Guzman]]. He also asks the player to let him know who ends up purchasing the hangar. The property is eventually acquired by the ''GTA Online'' Protagonist.

title: Trevor Philips
text:
Trevor has an athletic build. He has brown eyes and receding black hair. In his official [[Grand Theft Auto V/Artwork|artwork]], however, he has dark brown hair.

He also has several cuts on his face along with several tattoos including one along his neck featuring a dotted line and the words "CUT HERE", and a memorial tattoo for Michael on his shoulder, as well as a flying bird behind his ear, blazing skull on his left hand and the words "FUCK YOU" across his knuckles. Trevor has a visible scar on his abdomen from what looks to be a [[knife]] wound. Trevor also has numerous sores or boils over his lower stomach and back, likely from his drug addictions.

title: Trevor Philips
text:
Trevor's default outfit is a plain and dirty white V-neck, ripped up dirty blue jeans or sweatpants and a pair of brown boots. He is seen in one screenshot with a different outfit on—a jean jacket with a half buttoned up shirt along with a white undershirt and a pair of blue jeans. Also, in some screenshots, during the second [[Grand Theft Auto V/Trailers|trailer]] and wearing his default outfit, he is seen wearing a calculator watch on his left wrist.

During the [[Prologue (GTA V)|Prologue]], which took place 9 years before the game's events, Trevor sports a different appearance. He isn't bald (although his hairline has started to retreat and there's a small bald spot on the back of his head), has a mullet covering his entire back of the neck, and sports a mustache. These facial features can be purchased at [[barbers]] around Los Santos, although Trevor will still be balding with the mullet, like all his hair options. He also lacks his "CUT HERE" tattoo.

title: Trevor Philips
text: He seems fond of buying cheap clothing from Binco and the Discount Shop, while he shows total disdain for buying clothes from Ponsonby's. Some characters also mention that he is an extremely untidy and messy person when it comes to clothes and hygiene. When Michael and Trevor [[Fame or Shame (mission)|reunite]], Michael claims Trevor "[stinks] like piss" and has blood under his fingernails. During the [[Paleto Score Setup]], Michael calls Trevor a "proto-hipster" because his clothes are never clean and never fit. Also, [[Lamar Davis]] claims that Trevor has a "smell of ass on the distance of three meters."

title: Trevor Philips
text: There is a running joke during the story of ''GTA V'' of characters mistaking Trevor for some celebrity or movie actor. During the [[Strangers and Freaks]] mission [[Nigel and Mrs. Thornhill]], the couple [[Nigel]] and [[Mrs. Thornhill]] mistake Trevor for being the actor and stuntman [[Jock Cranley (HD Universe)|Jock Cranley]]. After [[Franklin]] met Trevor in [[Three's Company]], he brings him up to [[Beverly Felton]] during [[Paparazzo - The Partnership]], where Beverly initially believes Trevor was on the show [[The Men's Room]], which Franklin dismisses. There is also unique pedestrian dialogue for when the player is using Trevor, where pedestrians may mention how Trevor looks exactly like someone they saw in [[Midget Fuckers 22]].

title: Trevor Philips
text: Trevor has been described as a difficult person to deal with: extreme, impetuous, vengeful, sociopathic, unhinged, unpredictable, untamed, infamous, homicidal, and prone to violent outbursts and destructive rampages. He does everything in a sociopathic and relentless manner and, although he's like this, he's honest about it and will never show hypocrisy. He has his own charm along with his own principles. However, [[Dan Houser]] has confirmed that Trevor "may not be all he seems" and is still "too horrible" to be a hero of any kind. He is also quite insecure about being born in [[Canada]] and takes offense to people mocking his accent. Almost all of his [[Rampage (GTA V Missions)|Rampages]] are caused by Trevor flying into rage over being mocked over his Canadian accent. During a mission, Ron asks Trevor about his business dealings in Canada, resulting in Trevor getting defensive and demands for Ron to clarify. Ron hastily corrects himself by asking about Trevor's business dealings in North Yankton "along the Canadian border", defusing a possible violent outburst from Trevor, thus showing his insecurity for being Canadian. Also, while hanging out with Michael and [[Franklin Clinton|Franklin]], the former will sometimes remark "You're not even American." during a conversation. Somewhat enraged, Trevor will reply "I am! Fuck you!" and Michael will respond with "Whatever you say, eh." mocking Trevor's accent. This further shows his insecurity about being Canadian.

title: Trevor Philips
text: Trevor's mere presence always puts others on edge due to his extremely short temper and unpredictable, impulsive behavior. Ron, who is one of Trevor's friends and an unlikely one at that, is constantly terrified of him and frequently tries to appease Trevor whenever he can, especially if he is close to getting angry. Michael is also wary of him when they reunite, stepping in front of [[Jimmy De Santa|his son]] to protect him. Despite Ron's fear and Trevor's sociopathic behavior, they do seem to show a level of trust to each other as Trevor usually tasks [[Ron Jakowski|Ron]] to do a few missions for him such as blowing up [[The Lost MC]] fuel tank and helping him drop off cargo via a plane, as well as running [[Trevor Philips Enterprises]] in his absence. Wade, another friend, is equally scared of Trevor. Though Trevor torments and punches Wade often, this bullying extends to [[Wade Hebert|Wade]]'s cousin, [[Floyd Hebert|Floyd]], as well. Even strangers who have seen very little of him can be put off by his presence, shown when he instantly put [[Fabien LaRouche|Fabien]] on edge despite not even knowing him in the opening cutscene for the mission [[Fame or Shame (mission)|Fame or Shame]]. In [[The Merryweather Heist]], he gets angry quickly when his score is compromised. In the offshore ending, he gets so angry that he rams his face onto a wooden board and repeatedly smashes his face on it. His personality is stated to be partly based on that of legendary English prisoner , also known as "the most violent prisoner in Britain". He is a man known for his sudden violent outbursts which have earned him fame.

title: Trevor Philips
text: Out the three protagonists, Trevor can be said to be a true sociopath, as he easily kills with no remorse, has the typical parental issues (abandoned by his father and sensitive about his mother), is a pyromaniac, frequently abducts people and takes them to the [[Altruist Cult]] (the cult in question is implied to be made up of cannibalistic killers of which Trevor seems to be aware of) which he calls his "friends in the mountains" and has the habit of making sadistic jokes about his victims. For example, Trevor makes a joke about the piece of [[Johnny Klebitz]]'s brain left under his boot after he killed him, and telling [[Elwood O'Neil]] over the phone that Elwood had "too many [[O'Neil Brothers|brothers]]" and that they needed "culling". When Trevor kills Johnny, he demands that Johnny get up to face him, apparently unaware that he killed him. It is extremely unlikely that he cared though due to his plans to get rid of The Lost and how enraged he was with Johnny. In contrast with this behavior, however, is his protectiveness of Michael's family and his apparent grief when he thought Michael was dead, which shows a level of emotion not common in most sociopaths as they usually have little to no positive emotions for other people. In addition to this he refused to leave Michael in the prologue, while he was on the ground after being shot. Trevor seems to only care about the people very close to him and he can be truly loyal to them, which specifically includes his mother, Patricia Madrazo, [[Maude Eccles|Maude]], Michael, and later on even Franklin and Lamar. Brad's death affected him harshly, leaving him to blame Michael for what happened nine years ago back in North Yankton.

title: Trevor Philips
text: In contrast with his heavily sociopathic behavior, he has shown many times how needy he is for love and care. He tells Michael repeatedly how much he mourned him, to the point that he got a memorial tattoo with Michael's name on it. As he was being confronted by Floyd and Debra, he told them how much he wanted to be with them. His relationship with Patricia was also a display of true love and, in his words, he enjoyed a lot of the time spent with her.

title: Trevor Philips
text: Despite his weak relationship with [[Amanda De Santa|Amanda]] and having a strained friendship with Michael, Trevor does care for Jimmy and [[Tracey De Santa|Tracey]], viewing them as surrogate niece and nephew. Evidence of his caring is chasing [[Lazlow Jones (HD Universe)|Lazlow Jones]] when he does a sexual pose against Tracey as she performs a stripper-like dance and forcing him to take off his pants and dance in his underwear. Also, he will not allow Jimmy to drink alcohol when hanging out with him. Despite this, Trevor will insult Jimmy and Tracey when he encounters them outside of missions.

title: Trevor Philips
text: Trevor also seems to sometimes dwell on respect. When Wade calls [[Ashley Butler]] a "bitch", Trevor asks him if he thinks it's clever to disrespect women. He also often tells some of his friends to show some respect to himself, and sometimes even others. In the mission [[Trevor Philips Industries]], despite [[Chef]] worrying about the arrival of the [[Varrios Los Aztecas (HD Universe)|Aztecas]] at the meth lab, Trevor still orders him to show manners to [[Tao Cheng]] and [[Tao Cheng's Translator|his translator]] who want to see the meth lab operation, calling them as their "guests". When Wade is covered in sewage, Wade's cousin suggests calling the heist off, but Trevor responds by telling him to respect Wade for what he went through and so he should carry on with the heist.

title: Trevor Philips
text: Despite his behavior, Trevor possesses an awareness for guilt. This is seen in the [[Strangers and Freaks]] mission [[Minute Man Blues]] in which [[Manuel]], one of the innocent men captured by Trevor and the [[Civil Border Patrol]] members [[Joe (GTA V)|Joe]] and [[Josef]] on suspicion of being an illegal immigrant in the previous mission [[An American Welcome]], stands up to Trevor fearlessly despite the latter pointing a gun at him, and claims he and his family have migrated to America since more than 200 years ago, saying that he is more American than Trevor is. He criticizes Trevor for disregarding civil rights with "Trevor's friends", who are harassing innocent legal immigrants and, in Trevor's case, in return for money. He adds that, unlike the Civil Border Patrol, he will not give Trevor a single cent for helping him to stop the Civil Border Patrol. Fueled by this and Trevor having already felt the Civil Border Patrol's actions were indeed illegal, he storms into a rage and hunts down and puts an end to the Civil Border Patrol once and for all. Also, when Trevor runs over a main character, he will often scream "No!" in panic, although he may instead blame the person for being in his way in an unconcerned way.

title: Trevor Philips
text: Trevor uses threats of sexual violence to show his dominance over other men, as well as enjoying making them uncomfortable. Many of his sarcastic remarks have been misinterpreted as sincere statements by players. He seems to take it a step further with [[Floyd Hebert|Floyd]], as there are many things that suggest a sexual relationship. Notably, if the player switches to Trevor during his stay at Floyd’s condo, sometimes Trevor can be seen looking over Floyd as he lays in the fetal position wearing women's clothing, uttering an apology to [[Debra]] while sobbing. However, this could just be Trevor showing his dominance by humiliating Floyd. Also, if the player chooses to catch [[Ralph Ostrowski]], Trevor implies that he sexually abused men while in prison. It should be noted that this behavior is only present when in the presence of weak people such as Ron, Wade, Floyd, and a meth-addicted Johnny Klebitz.

title: Trevor Philips
text: On the other hand, he respects and encourages bravery on his friends and partners in crime. During job preparations, he often tends to taunt and call out anyone who shows a sign of doubt, fear or weakness, and when they get back angrily at him, Trevor applauds and approves their reaction as a way to man them up.

title: Trevor Philips
text: In direct contrast to his erratic and chaotic nature, Trevor also appears to be highly intelligent and somewhat cultured. Although seemingly lacking of refined tastes, Trevor speaks in the most eloquent manner out of all three protagonists, utilizing elaborate and complex vocabulary as well as displaying a surprisingly dry wit. It must be noted that having studied 4 years at a military academy, Trevor is the only ''GTA'' protagonist to date with a college degree, possibly explaining his use of complex vocabulary and hinting at a sophisticated nature that he might or might not be intentionally masking. Trevor is incredibly focused and professional on the jobs at hand, displaying a surprising capacity for calculation and planning, even under duress and in highly chaotic situations. He can follow the plans strictly and also he has proven to have great ideas for big jobs and lead them successfully, These include [[Series A|stealing the drug stashes belonging to many dangerous groups]] and [[The Merryweather Heist|stealing a multi-million secret weapon]] from a [[Merryweather Security|heavily armed security group]]. However, these operations were failures since they lacked a prior careful inspection and were performed hastily (one being a police sting, the other putting the crew in extreme danger worldwide).

title: Trevor Philips
text: Trevor has shown some hints that he feels genuine sexual attraction towards men too, besides his normal sexually dominant behavior towards weaker men. He showed certain interests in the "stag do running man" [[Random Events in GTA V|random encounter]]. While picking up a couple of hitchhikers, the very inebriated couple begins to have sex as Trevor drives the vehicle. He offers to join in and perform fellatio on the boyfriend. In the mission [[I Fought the Law...]], Trevor touches the private parts of one of the guys as he's dressed as a policeman. During a drinking outing with [[Franklin Clinton|Franklin]], he admits he has previously performed fellatio on men ("I'd rather suck a dick than smoke weed... and trust me, I've done both!"). In another conversation during an outing with [[Michael De Santa|Michael]] and Franklin at the same time, he admits he's bisexual after Franklin asked him whether he's gay or not.

title: Trevor Philips
text: Trevor is shown to be disgusted by racism, misogyny, as well as self-righteous and hypocritical attitudes which he considers "fake". He criticizes the Minute Men and the [[Los Santos Police Department (HD Universe)|LSPD]] for their racist behavior, reprimands Wade for his remarks toward Ashley, threatens Martin for mistreating Patricia, and is clearly disturbed by Josh Bernstein allowing Trevor to have sex with his wife (he claims he would not have done so if he knew, but then proceeds to take back this comment). After torturing Ferdinand Kerimov, he mocks the FIB's use of torture as a means of interrogation, claiming it is only a method of showing dominance and that the government fails to admit this. In one of his character switch scenes, he can even be throwing a Lost MC member off a bridge for being a bigot.

title: Trevor Philips
text: While it is never stated in-game, Trevor shows textbook signs of : a mental condition which includes episodes of impulsive behavior that could result in serious damage to anyone and anything around them, aggression grossly disproportionate to what provoked it, and episodic violence that cannot be categorized with any other existing mental and physical medical condition.

title: Trevor Philips
text: Trevor also appears to suffer from , since in [[Grass Roots - Trevor]], dialogue suggests that Trevor once was or still is scared of clowns, saying such things as "I'm a big boy now" and "you can't hurt me anymore" (paraphrasing). He might also ask the clowns, "Are there any more sex offenders out there!?" This implies that, as a child, Trevor was sexually assaulted by a clown, thus causing his fear of clowns. Additionally, when the player gets Lamar, Franklin, and Trevor to hang out together off-mission, Franklin will mention he's sitting next to "Two Clowns" (Trevor and Lamar). Trevor then starts to get a little worried, asking, "Clown? Where?!" which may prove he is still scared of clowns.

title: Trevor Philips
text: Although very rarely seen in-game, Trevor appears to be secretly ashamed and a bit scared of his personality. When hanging out with both Michael and Franklin simultaneously, Trevor might reveal in an ashamed tone that he doesn't want his mother to see him like this. If Trevor hangs out with Lamar enough times, he will admit to Lamar that sometimes he realizes how he's thinking (fixation on violence, horrible brutalities etc.) and gets scared of himself. If Trevor huffs gas on his trailer porch, he may sometimes mutter that he feels suicidal. This could hint that all the reckless stunts Trevor commits (such as flying a [[Duster]] inside a cargo plane while getting shot at with an [[RPG]]) might be subconscious attempts of getting killed. When drunk with Franklin, Trevor talks about being lonely and asks Franklin to hold him. When Franklin replies with jokes, Trevor starts crying, "Why are you joking!? I said I'm lonely!"

title: Trevor Philips
text:
While Trevor is often controlling, loud, and willing to hurt anyone who he perceives as a threat in some way, whether physically or mentally, he is terrified by his mother. Upon meeting her in his trailer in the mission [[Mrs. Philips (mission)|Mrs. Philips]], he speaks incoherent sentences, is unable to answer questions and runs off to do the job she assigns to him without questioning it.

Trevor is also extremely talented at mathematics. According to Wade, Trevor is "really good with numbers" and can solve even the most difficult of math problems in his head in a matter of seconds without much (if any) hesitation, as seen in the Depository heist.

title: Trevor Philips
text: '''[[Michael De Santa]]''' - Trevor's relationship with Michael started around the late 1980s, over twenty years prior to the game's events, when he and Trevor were escorting cargo across the border. Trevor claims that Michael's victim came after him, so Trevor shot a [[Flare Gun|flare]] into the other man's head and dumped the body using his plane (which Trevor claimed "Never smelled the same again."), and as soon as they left the plane, they both threw up and became friends. Michael roped Trevor into his many bank robberies and the two worked well together, growing a fondness for one another. At some point during their long partnership, however, there was a rift in their friendship, likely caused by Michael starting a family and wishing to settle down. Trevor began seeing Michael as "soft", but remained loyal to him and refused to abandon him even when Brad suggested that they cut him off. Unbeknownst to Trevor, Michael did not share his levels of loyalty, seeing Trevor as a reckless and dangerous psychopath. This eventually led him to make a secret deal with FIB agent Dave Norton to sell out his crew during their heist in North Yankton, after which both Trevor and Michael assumed one another to be dead. Trevor would subsequently mourn for Michael and at some point had "R.I.P Michael" tattooed on his arm to commemorate his best friend.

title: Trevor Philips
text: After their eventual reunion nine years later, Trevor is initially furious with Michael for not contacting him at any point after starting his new life in Los Santos, but quickly forgives him and the two resume their old friendship and partnership. Trevor seems to share a strange bond with Michael, as indicated by the fact that he tolerates his betrayal and occasional references to Trevor's Canadian roots, whereas others have been killed for far less. Once Trevor figures out what truly went down in North Yankton, however, he contemplates killing Michael before abandoning him to the mercy of [[Wei Cheng]]'s [[Los Santos Triads|henchmen]], later refusing to rescue him even when Wei Cheng contacts Trevor to tell him that Michael will be killed. After Franklin rescues Michael, Trevor, despite still hating the latter, comes to his aid during the shootout at the [[Kortz Center]], believing he needs Michael alive for their final score: the Union Depository heist. After the heist is pulled off successfully, Trevor is so pleased that he no longer wants to kill Michael, though he still sees him as a "snake".

title: Trevor Philips
text: In [[Something Sensible]], after Michael arrives to help Franklin kill Trevor, the latter states, ''I thought I was with one Judas! I'm surrounded by them.'' He then allows the pair to kill him, being so hurt by the betrayal of his closest friends that he has lost his will to live. In [[The Time's Come]], Franklin calls Trevor to help him kill Michael, but he refuses, saying he has enough "traitors" in his life. If Franklin meets with Trevor afterwards, the latter deduces that Franklin went through with killing Michael and calls him a ''Judas'' and a ''backstabber'' before warning him to stay away. It is implied Trevor was willing to forgive Michael, but never got the chance to apologize. In [[The Third Way]], Trevor and Michael continue to be at odds and aim their guns at each other until Franklin calms them down and explains that they need to work together to eliminate their enemies. Trevor is the first to relent and lower his gun, after which he, Michael and Franklin take out their various foes. In the aftermath, Trevor and Michael finally manage to rekindle their friendship, with Trevor considering Michael a friend, albeit one that he hates, which Michael accepts. If Trevor and Michael hang out afterwards, the latter extends a genuine apology to Trevor and offers him his share of the Big Score; Trevor declines the money but accepts the apology. On a subsequent hangout, Trevor will also apologize to Michael, claiming he shouldn't have acted the way he did. If Franklin hangs out with Trevor, he will ask him why he did not kill Michael, to which Trevor admits that he somewhat understands why Michael did what he did and that it would be wrong to kill him since he has a family. He also jokingly states that he and Michael both have "custody" over Franklin.

title: Trevor Philips
text: '''[[Franklin Clinton]]''' - Trevor is introduced to Franklin by Michael. They seem to be very good partners during the jobs they perform together, and later become close friends. Franklin is one of the few people who doesn't feel intimidated by Trevor's rage and violent outbursts. In fact, he usually manages to cool Trevor down in a collected manner. In the optional ending that involves [[Something Sensible|killing]] Trevor, he protests that he's been nothing but straight and true with Franklin. In the ending where Franklin [[The Time's Come|kills]] Michael, Trevor would cut off ties with him and claim that he's dead to him. Should all three protagonists [[The Third Way|survive]], Trevor will continue to see Franklin as a friend and tell him that he's "proud" of him when they hang out.

title: Trevor Philips
text: '''[[Ron Jakowski]]''' - Ron is the closest thing Trevor has to a "friend", besides Franklin and Michael, though their relationship is very one-sided. Trevor frequently abuses Ron both physically and verbally for his own amusement, while Ron only hangs around him out of fear, being very paranoid or outright terrified when spending time with Trevor. Despite Ron often being on the end of Trevor's temper, Trevor places high levels of trust in him, such as allowing him to run TP Enterprises in his absence. When introducing Ron to Michael, Trevor describes him as a "good guy, very loyal," and after Ron sources getaway vehicles for the duo in [[Derailed]], Trevor describes him as "dependable".

title: Trevor Philips
text: '''[[Wade Hebert]]''' - Wade appears to be good "friends" with Trevor and has been since they met the year before the events of the game. Wade is extremely loyal to Trevor and has no problem following his directions. Wade's stupidity and child-like personality cause him to occasionally screw up his tasks, which understandably gets on Trevor's nerves. In spite of Trevor being annoyed by Wade, he does generally care about him since he is useful for his business plans. Trevor also sees potential in Wade, as evidenced by the time when they met and Trevor caused Wade's friends Kush-Chronic and Daisy Bell to "disappear", while sparing Wade himself.

title: Trevor Philips
text: '''[[Floyd Hebert]]''' - Floyd appears to be terrified of Trevor. He's forced by Trevor to help him in his crimes, under menace of having his home and furniture trashed. In the mission [[Hang Ten]], he finally decides to stand up to Trevor, along with his girlfriend [[Debra]], ordering him to leave their condo. After a heated discussion, Debra pulls a gun on Trevor, and Floyd draws a knife to defend himself, making Trevor presumably kill both of them off-screen. Despite this, deep down Trevor may have actually cared for Floyd's miserable life, as in the mission [[Scouting the Port]] he spoke to Wade about bringing Floyd up from his low self-esteem. Later, he got out his penis to rest Floyd's insecurity about his own (though maybe for different reasons than care). He also notably had a concerned facial expression when Debra called Floy "crap" shortly before their murder.

title: Trevor Philips
text: '''[[Mrs. Philips]]''' - Trevor's mother is only seen during the [[Strangers and Freaks]] mission [[Mrs. Philips (mission)|Mrs. Philips]]. She is implied to have been an abusive and neglectful parent, while at the same time having very high expectations of her son and constantly chastising him. Before the events of the game, she was a stripper/prostitute, as seen in her and Trevor's comments (he states this sometimes when having a private dance). She was also an inmate and became disappointed in Trevor because he never wrote or visited her. During her mission, she asks if Trevor has found a woman yet and does not let him answer the question. She also asks if he's gay, because she has no problem with it. After the mission, she disappears and Trevor is seen crying on the floor. She is highly respected by Trevor, and he gets insulted should anyone ever bring her up, even if they are speaking positively of her. She is the only known person Trevor is afraid of.

title: Trevor Philips
text: '''[[Patricia Madrazo]]''' - Trevor first met Patricia when visiting her [[Martin Madrazo|husband's]] house alongside Michael, and immediately developed an attraction towards her. After Martin refuses to pay him for his work, Trevor, seeing how neglected and abused Patricia is by her husband, decides to kidnap her and hold her hostage at his trailer in [[Sandy Shores]]. As time goes on, Patricia is no longer tied up and is seen cooking meals for Trevor, which leads Michael to suggest both have contracted Stockholm syndrome. Trevor soon becomes protective of Patricia, and admits that he loves her and vice versa. When he is forced to return her to Martin, he does so tearfully and promises to rip off Martin's other ear if Trevor finds out he has been mistreating Patricia yet again. For the rest of the game, Patricia will secretly call Trevor on occasion. During the events of [[GTA Online: The Cayo Perico Heist|The Cayo Perico Heist]] in 2020, their relationship is confirmed to have been intimate, as they took pictures during their intercourse.

title: Trevor Philips
text: '''[[Lamar Davis]]''' - Lamar first met Trevor during the mission [[Hood Safari]]. Though Lamar initially felt uneasy in Trevor's presence and repeatedly asked Franklin who he was, he soon grew to like him, nicknaming him "Crazy White Dude" due to Trevor's behavior, and even telling Franklin to learn from his being "cold". Lamar will also warmly greet Trevor when meeting him during [[Lamar Down]].

title: Trevor Philips
text: '''[[Steve Haines]]''' - Trevor first meets Haines during a job to extract [[Ferdinand Kerimov]] from the IAA headquarters, and takes an immediate dislike of him. Haines forces him, Michael and Franklin into his operations, with Trevor in particular having to torture Kerimov to extract information that can be used to identify and kill [[Tahir Javan]]. Haines also gets the protagonists to perform several heists for him. However, more and more suspicion from the [[Federal Investigation Bureau|FIB]] falls on Haines, causing him to become extremely paranoid. He, along with [[Andreas Sanchez]], confronts Michael and [[Dave Norton]] at the [[Kortz Center]] and attempts to have them framed and arrested for ruining his career. After an ambush by the IAA, Merryweather and rival FIB forces, Haines kills Sanchez and escapes, leaving Michael and Norton to die; however, they manage to shoot their way out, with the assistance of Trevor, who wants Michael alive for the "Big Score". After the shootout, an infuriated Haines wishes to have Trevor, Michael and Franklin killed; Norton convinces him to have only Trevor killed as Franklin and Michael are easier to control. Haines then tasks Franklin with killing Trevor. If "Deathwish" is chosen, the protagonists team up and take down Haines' corrupt FIB unit and Devin Weston's private Merryweather battalion at a foundry, after which Trevor volunteers to deal with Haines, claiming he wanted to kill him from the moment they met. Using information provided by [[Lester Crest]], Trevor finds Haines shooting an episode [[The Underbelly Of Paradise|of his show]] on a ferris wheel at [[Del Perro Pier]], and kills him.

title: Trevor Philips
text: '''[[Devin Weston]]''' - Trevor meets Weston for the first time during a job for Steve Haines. Weston later offers Michael an opportunity to produce a film with Michael's idol - movie producer [[Solomon Richards]] - and also offers Franklin and Trevor a deal to steal five rare cars, which Weston will sell to government officials in China. However, he ultimately cheats them out of their payment, and also attempts to have Michael's family [[Meltdown (GTA V)|killed]] after Michael accidentally caused the death of Devin's [[Molly Schultz|lawyer]]. This incident leads Weston to order Franklin to kill Michael. If "Deathwish" is chosen, [[The Third Way|Trevor, Michael and Franklin take out Haines' corrupt FIB unit and Weston's Merryweather battalion at a foundry, after which they kill Haines, Stretch and Wei Cheng]]. After killing Haines, Trevor kidnaps Devin from his [[Devin Weston's Mansion|mansion]], shoves him inside the trunk of one of his cars, and drives him to a cliff, located at the foothills of [[Mount Chiliad]]. Michael and Franklin later show up and the three protagonists taunt a beaten Devin before pushing the car (with him still inside the trunk) off the cliff. The car repeatedly crashes into several rocks along the way, until it finally hits the [[Pacific Ocean (HD Universe)|ocean]] ground and explodes, killing Weston.

title: Trevor Philips
text: '''''' - The ''GTA Online'' Protagonist first fell under Trevor's radar when they unwittingly stole an RV used by Trevor as a meth lab for [[Gerald]]. Upon realizing he cannot intimidate them, Trevor forces the Protagonist to carry out several jobs for him in order to pay back the debt he feels they owe him, eventually retaining their services in order to [[Series A|set up a drug deal]]. Trevor's relationship with the ''GTA Online'' Protagonist is surprisingly civil as he likely sees them as someone who is similar to him: a lost soul willing to commit whatever crime, no matter how dirty, as long as they're adequately paid for their services.

title: Trevor Philips
text:
Because he is a former military aviation pilot, he is skilled in both combat and piloting aircraft like helicopters. In the mission [[Three's Company]], Trevor was the one that flew the team to the skyscraper they needed to get their target out of. In the aftermath, as the team was pursued by law enforcement helicopters, he proved to be an able pilot under pressure.

Trevor is also the master of greed, ambition, and insanity (along with Michael and Franklin), and is seen in many ''GTA V'' screenshots performing many challenging (and some illegal) stunts. Some of those stunts include base jumping, jet-skiing, murdering, property destruction, arson, jumping out from moving vehicles and getting chased by the cops.

title: Trevor Philips
text:
Wade also said that Trevor is "good with numbers", implying that he has good mathematical skills. This is confirmed during small talk with a bank executive during the Subtle approach to the final heist; upon being told the number of gold bricks they are stealing and the size of each one, Trevor rattles off the exact amount of gold they have before the executive can finish entering the above information into his calculator. Trevor also has an excellent perception and intuition, being the only one to figure out that the brick of coke Franklin and Lamar were buying from the Ballas at Grove Street was actually drywall.

He also proved to be a good strategist and planner. He alone pulled a successful heist on Merryweather Security Consulting, and he's been able to keep his relatively small organization peaking up in the drug and arms dealing against other bigger and more dangerous groups like the Aztecas, The Lost or the Marabunta Grande.

title: Trevor Philips
text:
He also proved to be a powerful hand-to-hand combatant, usually knocking down people with a single punch in [[Fresh Meat (mission)|several]] [[Exercising Demons - Trevor|cutscenes]]. He's strong enough to lift and throw people off ledges in several of his [[Switch Scenes|switch scenes]].

Trevor's [[Special Ability|special ability]] is ''Invulnerability''. While active, Trevor can take an excessive amount of damage without dying as well as a special melee attack that he can perform. By enhancing this skill, the player can increase its maximum storage capacity, which directly affects its duration. Trevor's Special skill lasts for 30 seconds when the Stat Bar for Special skill has been maxed out. While in the ability, he can survive hits from trains, [[Rhino (HD Universe)|Rhino]] tank cannon shots and being mauled by a [[Cougars|mountain lion]].
