title: Mr. Philips
text:
*No Survivors - Kill all fleeing bikers.
**Take out all members on the left entrance road first, remembering to kill with headshots where possible, using Trevor's special ability can also help. After taking out the members on the left hand side of the park, proceed through the center of the park, taking out the members escaping on bikes from the left. Exploding the gas canisters next to the trailers on the right entrance road can also eliminate any remaining bikers. After the majority are killed, up to three remaining bikers will be indicated on the map with flashing blue/red markers, these bikers are the ones to be killed to gain the objective. If the player stuck to the left of the park, these members will usually flee to the main road, rather than the hills, making it easier to reach and kill them. They will not retaliate.
*Headshots - Get 12 headshots.
**Kill as many enemies as possible with a headshot. Using Trevor's special ability is advised, and using shotguns close range, with time to concentrate on the head of the target can also be effective
*Time - Complete within 12:00.
** Skip cutscenes and avoid chasing remaining members as a very last resort. Use the available shortcuts enroute if possible.
*Trailer Trashed - Cause $5,000 damage to Ortega's trailer.
**Make sure to push the trailer fully into the river by continuing the accelerate against it while it rolls down the banking.
*Lost and Damned - Kill Terry and Clay during the chase.
**As Trevor states at the beginning of the chase, the gang members in the van need to be kept while the two escort bikers can go; take out the bikers at the beginning of the chase to avoid losing them in the park later on.

title: Mr. Philips
text:
*The player can now play as Trevor, and [[Trevor's Trailer|his trailer]] becomes available as a [[Safehouses in GTA V|safehouse]]. However, the player cannot play as Michael or Franklin for several missions (as it is mentioned that they are laying low after the [[The Jewel Store Job|heist]]) until they complete [[Friends Reunited]] (Franklin) and [[Fame or Shame (mission)|Fame or Shame]] (Michael).
*It is possible to call both Ron and Wade after the mission. If the player does so, they will hear two unique conversations between the characters.
**The first time Trevor is able to call Ron can only be triggered if the player stays in Trevor's trailer. Otherwise, Ron will call Trevor instead. Either way, they will discuss meeting with [[Tao Cheng]] at the [[Yellow Jack Inn]]. With any of these calls, the next mission, [[Trevor Philips Industries]], is unlocked.
***The transcript in the first phone call between Ron and Trevor will vary depending on who calls first.
*The protagonists can now use [[Tattoo Parlors]], and partake in [[Offroad Races]].
*The Lost MC are now hostile towards Trevor and will always attack or pursue him if they notice him.
*Trevor gets an email from [[Brad Snider|Brad]] in which Brad wishes Trevor well, as he wrote to Trevor after some time. He also states that he might be allowed to have visitors and encourages Trevor to turn himself in as [[Bolingbroke Penitentiary|prison]] isn't that bad and Trevor might like it, or at the very least to stay out of trouble. He grieves for [[Michael De Santa|Michael]] and hopes for his betterment in the afterlife. At last, he jokes about Trevor not asking him whether he has a boyfriend as a prison taboo and states that the taboo is not true unless Trevor wants it.
**Trevor can send a response to this email and reveals to Brad that although it is hardly believable, [[Michael De Santa|Mike]] is alive and living in Los Santos, as he saw it on TV.
**According to the mission [[By the Book]], it is revealed that it is actually [[Dave Norton]] who is impersonating Brad the whole time, as Brad has been dead for almost a decade.
***This is proven true if [[The Time's Come]] (option B) or [[The Third Way]] (option C) are completed, as Dave will send Trevor an email confirming that he was the one who impersonated Brad the whole time. No email will be sent if [[Something Sensible]] (option A) is completed, as Trevor will be dead.
*Trevor also gets an email from Ron about the [[Altruist Cult]] and their [[Altruist Camp|camp]] in the mountains, in which Trevor is informed about the [[Random Events in GTA V|lost souls]] that he can bring to them for salvation, in exchange for easy money, as the cultists want to have them for dinner.
*The boarded up window at [[Premium Deluxe Motorsport]] (due to the previous one being destroyed in [[Complications]]) will be replaced with a new one. However, the new window is indestructible and cannot be damaged in any way. In addition, vehicles will no longer spawn inside the dealership, nor is the showroom accessible any longer.

title: Mr. Philips
Mr. Philips
text:
*[[Johnny Klebitz|Johnny]]'s jacket says "Vice President" despite him having become President of The Lost MC after mission [[This Shit's Cursed]].
*If the player throws an explosive close to [[Ashley Butler|Ashley]] and Johnny (close enough so that Ashley reacts, but is not killed), she and Johnny will stand back up. If Trevor gets too close to them, Johnny will drop back dead and Ashley will run away.
*When chasing the bikers, if the player destroys the [[Gang Burrito|van]], the player can continue to [[Stab City]]. When the player arrives at Stab City, however, the game will crash and Trevor will be unable to exit the vehicle.
*If the player opens the pause menu during the first [[Cutscenes|cutscene]] (before Trevor's first appearance), the current character will be Trevor. The time of day will be 13:00.
*When Trevor and Ron arrive at [[Ortega]]'s [[Ortega's Trailer|trailer]], the conversation between them in the following cutscene may not play, and the mission may continue directly from there.
*Rarely, on the way back to [[Trevor's Trailer|Trevor's trailer]] after pushing Ortega's trailer into the river, Trevor's [[Bodhi]] may be limited to travelling below 60 mph, and cannot be exceeded until reaching the trailer.
*Before completing the first objective, if the player dies when Trevor, Ron, and Wade are in Trevor's Bodhi, the old Ron and Wade will not get deleted when retrying the mission, leading to duplicated characters.
*If the player fails the mission during the chase, they will be able to kill the member driving the van after they restart. The van will still continue to drive by itself after the player kills the driver. This can be seen ASyC-T0O2FE|here}}.

title: Mr. Philips
text:
*During the opening cutscene, Trevor zips up his pants after having sex with Ashley, despite the fact he is wearing sweatpants.
*If the player kills Ashley before Wade has a chance to suggest killing her to cover their tracks, the player can hear unique dialogue where Trevor will remark on the fact that he would still like to destroy The Lost MC, although the rest of the dialogue will remain the same.
*If the player starts this mission using Michael, they can see a unique conversation between Michael and [[Amanda De Santa|Amanda]] at the beginning of the cutscene. 
*Before the mission, Franklin can explore the mansion's entryway, backyard, garage, kitchen, and upstairs level freely.
*When talking with Dave, Michael brings up his belief of Trevor supposedly being dead. This was previously mentioned in Michael's conversation with Lester during [[Casing the Jewel Store]].
*After choosing Ortega's fate, the radio station will be tuned into [[Rebel Radio]] and "I Ain't Living Long Like This" by will always play, while Trevor drives himself and Ron back to their trailers.
*If the player replays this mission, Trevor will be wearing his default set of clothing. However, if Trevor dies during the mission, he will respawn at the hospital wearing the clothes he was wearing before the mission.
*If [[Trevor Philips Industries]] is replayed, [[Chef]] will act as if Trevor spared Ortega in this mission, even if he killed him.
*During the chase sequence, one may find the following vehicles on the road: a white utility [[Bison]] passing the player at the start of the dirt road, a [[Scrap Truck]] after the sharp turn, a [[Dozer]] after passing a ramp, a rusty light blue [[Emperor]] before passing a wooden bridge, a green/dark blue [[Towtruck]] passing in front of a metal bridge and a dark gray [[Duneloader]] going to an adjacent road near a third bridge. The said vehicles will also drive faster than usual vehicles driving on the dirt road.
*At certain points during the mission, Ron and Trevor will foreshadow the events of several later missions:
**During the chase sequence, Ron will mention Lost MC members at [[Sandy Shores Airfield]].
**On the way to Ortega's trailer, Ron will mention [[Tao Cheng|a Chinese contact]] and the [[O'Neil Brothers]].
**On the way back to Trevor's trailer, Trevor will explain his [[Friends Reunited|plan to find]] and deal with [[Michael Townley]].
*Players returning to Stab City after successfully completing this mission will find the destructible trailer containing the meth lab destroyed, regardless of whether it was destroyed during the mission.

title: The Merryweather Heist
text:
'''The Merryweather Heist''' is a [[Heists in GTA V|heist]] mission in , undertaken by [[Michael De Santa]], [[Franklin Clinton]] and [[Trevor Philips]].

As the mission [[Three's Company]] features the first meeting of Trevor and Franklin, it and the mission [[By the Book]] must be completed before the main heist is unlocked, though the preparation missions can be done in advance of this.

title: The Merryweather Heist
text: In order to perform the heist, Trevor must perform a couple of [[Heist Setups|preparation missions]] to obtain the necessary equipment. The number of preparation missions depends on the approach, though both approaches require the player to acquire a [[Submersible]].

title: The Merryweather Heist
text: For this approach, only one preparation mission ([[Minisub]]) is required. If this approach is chosen, Trevor phones Franklin and advises him to visit the [[Ammu-Nation Shooting Ranges|Shooting Range]] to improve his shooting skills.

title: The Merryweather Heist
text: Two preparation missions ([[Cargobob (mission)|Cargobob]] and [[Minisub]]) are required for this approach. If this approach is chosen, Trevor phones Michael and advises him to visit the [[Flight School]] to improve his pilot skills.

title: The Merryweather Heist
text: Depending on the chosen method in [[Scouting the Port]], the entire mission will play out in one of two ways:

title: The Merryweather Heist
text:
''Despite Franklin being advised to visit the Shooting Range, this is not compulsory''.

Trevor, Michael and Franklin meet at [[Floyd Hebert|Floyd's]] [[Floyd's Apartment|apartment]], where Trevor explains the plan. Trevor and Franklin get into Trevor's [[Bodhi|truck]] and drive to the [[Miriam Turner Overpass]]. Trevor drops Franklin off and Franklin heads to the vantage point. A few in-game hours pass and the mission resumes at dusk. The player is [[Switch Scenes|switched]] to Michael, who is waiting next to the [[SS Bulker|freighter]] in a [[Dinghy]]. Michael dives into the [[water]] and makes his way onto the freighter.

title: The Merryweather Heist
text:
Michael boards the freighter and makes his way inside, whilst Franklin covers him by killing the [[Merryweather Security|Merryweather]] guards with a [[Sniper Rifle|sniper rifle]]. Franklin kills the guards, and Michael plants four [[Sticky Bombs|sticky bombs]] in various positions on the ship.
At this point, Michael is spotted by some other guards. The player is switched to Franklin, who kills the guards pursuing Michael and shoots down a Merryweather [[Buzzard Attack Chopper|helicopter]]. Once the guards have been killed, Michael leaves the freighter and Franklin detonates the bombs, sinking the freighter in the process.
The player regains control of Michael, who is searching the freighter's wreckage using [[Scuba Suit|dive gear]]. Michael locates the device, which is then collected by Trevor, who is piloting a [[Submersible]]. On shore, Floyd uses a crane to lift the Submersible onto the dock. At this point, [[Lester Crest]] arrives wearing hospital clothing, and warns the trio that the device they've stolen is a highly-dangerous super weapon and that they must return it immediately. Trevor refuses, but Michael promises to find another "score" for Trevor. Lester leaves with Floyd to return the device, while Michael and Franklin drive off, leaving an angered Trevor alone on the harbour.

title: The Merryweather Heist
text: ''Despite Michael being advised to visit the Flight School, this is not compulsory.''

title: The Merryweather Heist
text: Trevor, Michael and Franklin meet at Floyd's apartment, where Trevor explains the plan. Trevor, Michael and Franklin get into Trevor's truck and Michael drives them to the [[Sandy Shores Airfield]]. The trio arrive at the airfield, where Trevor enters the Submersible delivered by [[Wade Hebert|Wade]] and Floyd in the [[Packer]]. Michael uses the [[Cargobob]] to lift the Submersible, and they fly to the Merryweather test site in the [[Pacific Ocean (HD Universe)|Pacific Ocean]], near [[Paleto Cove]]. Michael releases the Submersible close to the test site, and Trevor uses a [[Trackify]] app to locate the device. Trevor finds the device and ascends to the surface. The player is switched to Michael, who lifts the Submersible out of the ocean with the Cargobob. En route to the airstrip, the Cargobob is attacked by Merryweather helicopters and boats, but Franklin manages to fend off the pursuers with a [[Combat MG]].

title: The Merryweather Heist
text: Michael lands the Cargobob back at the airfield. At this point, Lester Crest appears and warns the trio to return the device as it is a highly-dangerous super weapon, and would make them targets for the authorities. Trevor refuses, but relents when Michael promises to find him another "score". Lester leaves with Wade to return the device and Michael drives off with Franklin. Trevor repeatedly hits his head on a wooden forklift pallet out of rage.

title: The Merryweather Heist
text: ''"Container ship sinks in the [[Port of Los Santos|port]] of [[South Los Santos]]. Witnesses describe a scene of chaos in Los Santos harbor earlier as several explosions could be seen on board a container ship, which subsequently sunk into the harbor. Reports suggest nothing was stolen and foul play is non-suspected in the incident."''

title: The Merryweather Heist
text:
''Containership sinks into LS harbour: Merryweather fumble their first play.''

''Shelia Hitano - Daily Globe''

title: The Merryweather Heist
text: "''Explosions ran through the Port of South Los Santos last night and a container ship sunk into the harbor. This isn't how [[Don Percival]], CEO of Merryweather Security Consulting, wanted to celebrate his company getting clearance to work at the [[Port of Los Santos]]. Along with a high value courier service, running a special security detail at the Port is one of the main contracts Merryweather have taken on since Congress gave them a domestic pass. Despite some witnesses claiming to hear gunfire, Percival insisted that the ship was sunk due to explosions in a malfunctioning gas tank. Anti-Merryweather activists point to a similar incident in the [[Sudan]] where Merryweather soldiers, drunk and full of steroids, accidentally engaged other Merryweather soldiers in a "combat situation", then attempted to blame it on local insurgents. A full investigation into the incident has been launched.''"

text:
*There is a glitch present during the freighter approach. The optional achievement of 80% accuracy will not be awarded even if the player's accuracy is 100%, making it impossible to achieve a gold medal for this mission. This can be fixed by deleting the patch (which could only be deleted in a cracked console or on a [[Personal Computer|PC]]) and ignoring the game's request to reinstall the patch. This glitch is not present in the offshore approach.
*A glitch on both next gen and old gen versions during the freighter method may result in [[Franklin Clinton|Franklin]] losing the ability to zoom in and out with the [[Sniper Rifle|sniper rifle]] after the [[Cutscenes|cutscene]] showing Michael entering the ship, rendering it next to impossible to complete this part of the mission.
*If the freighter method was chosen, after completing the mission and [[Switch Scenes|switching]] to Michael, he'll have maximum ammo on all his weapons.
*A glitch can occur after this mission is completed. If [[Michael De Santa|Michael]] bought weapons from a [[Ammu-Nation (HD Universe)|gun shop]] before this mission, they will disappear when finishing this mission. The cause of this glitch is unknown.
*A glitch can occur if replaying the offshore approach. Michael and Franklin may drive to the [[Sandy Shores Airfield|airfield]] with [[Trevor Philips|Trevor]] already in the [[Submersible|submarine]] once they arrive, and the [[Cargobob]] will be there. Franklin will assume it to be the chopper, and it will be flyable, but the ability to pick up and drop the submarine from the Cargobob may be unavailable.

title: The Merryweather Heist
text:
*The freighter approach to the heist has been implied to be the [[canon]] approach: 
**The heist was originally going to be called "The Port of LS Heist".
**No matter which method is chosen, [[EyeFind]] will still report that the freighter was attacked; however, the [[Bleeter]] posts will be different. This could just be an oversight.
**In the mission [[The Wrap Up]], [[Dave Norton]] mentions [[Trevor Philips|Trevor]] robbing [[Merryweather Security|Merryweather]]'s "[[Minor Turbulence|planes]], [[Derailed|trains]] and boats".
**In a hang out between the trio after [[The Third Way]], Trevor mentions the heists all three of them did together, including this one. No matter what approach has been taken, he will mention "the operation Merryweather was running out the Port of LS".
**Interestingly, the [[SS Bulker]] is still intact and active as a freighter as of [[2019]], as one of the [[Heist Prep: Getaway Vehicles|Getaway Vehicles]] prep missions for [[The Diamond Casino Heist]] requires the player to steal the vehicles from the freighter. Assuming this approach was canon, with the state it was in after the heist, the freighter would have no longer been seaworthy and most likely would have been scrapped.
***Alternatively, the Offshore approach may have been added to the game relatively late in development (the mentions of the Port being robbed and the aforementioned original name support this) rather than it not being canon.
*If the offshore method is chosen, the dialogue between Trevor and Michael on the way to the airfield will change depending on whether the player completed the first two [[Flight School]] lessons as Michael.
**If the player didn't complete any Flight School lesson, Trevor will be mad at Michael.
**If the player completed only the first lesson, or if they attained a bronze medal in either of the first two lessons, Michael will say that he took the lessons, but didn't "go crazy" with them.
**If the player completed the first two lessons with a silver or gold medal, Trevor will be pleased.
*If the freight method is chosen, the dialogue between Trevor and Franklin on the way to the [[Miriam Turner Overpass|bridge]], will change depending on whether the player, as Franklin, has completed the [[Ammu-Nation Shooting Ranges|Shooting Range]] or not.
**Trevor will be pleased if Franklin did as he suggested, otherwise, Trevor will blame him in the dialogue.
*The Submersible used during this mission is much more durable than the one found at the [[Sonar Collections Dock]]. It is able to withstand the pressure at the farthest point (0.15 miles) that the player can descend to in the ocean, which normally the submersible will be destroyed in free roam.
*The exact nature of the device that is the target of the heist is unknown, Trevor speculates that it may be a new type of generator or bomb. [[Lester Crest|Lester]] simply refuses to take possession of it and orders Trevor to return it before Merryweather and the [[United States of America|US]] hunt them all down, saying that it's an "experimental super weapon".
*Scenes from both approaches of this mission appeared in the official [[Grand Theft Auto V/Trailers|trailer]] for the game.
*Franklin will receive an e-mail from [[Brother Adrian]] after this mission, asking him to go to their [[Childrenofthemountain.com|website]] to join the [[Children of the Mountain]] brotherhood. However, this does not appear to be the case on [[PlayStation 4|PS4]] version.
*Although one would think the events of this mission would impact Merryweather's finances, they seem to have no impact on its stock price, or that of its competitor, [[Gruppe Sechs (HD Universe)|Gruppe Sechs]].
*Although listed as the second [[Heists in GTA V|heist]], it is possible to engage in the third heist, [[Blitz Play]], first, making this the third heist.

title: The Merryweather Heist
text:
*In the [[Beta Content in GTA V|beta]], [[Wade Hebert|Wade]] was wearing [[Fooliganz|Fooligan]] makeup in the initial [[Cutscenes|cutscene]].
*If Trevor drives Franklin to the sniper nest location in his [[Bodhi|truck]], Franklin will randomly either get into the front seat alongside Trevor or hop into the back of the truck.
**Additionally, if Trevor's truck or any other vehicle isn't around to drive Franklin to his vantage point, Franklin's [[Buffalo S|car]] will immediately appear to do the task.
*If the mission [[Hood Safari]] has been completed previously to this mission, Trevor and Franklin will mention the events of that mission on the way to the bridge.
*Franklin makes a reference to the events of the mission [[Three's Company]] while the [[Buzzard]] is trying to kill him. He says, "This is the second time one of those evil helicopters comes after me, Trevor and the [[Federal Investigation Bureau|FIB]] are bad news!".
**Moreover, the [[protagonist]]s' tasks are similar to the ones they had in that mission, with Michael dressed in all-black attire locating the designated cargo, Franklin perched above an elevated area providing sniper support, and Trevor controlling the transportation used to extract their cargo.
*During the ending scene, Lester can be seen arriving at the pier in a [[Taxi]] on the [[PlayStation 3]] and [[Xbox 360]] versions of the game. In the [[Grand Theft Auto V: Enhanced Edition|enhanced version]], however, the Taxi is nowhere to be seen.
*This approach is similar to events depicted in [[Bomb Da Base: Act II]] in , as the [[protagonist]] (Franklin/[[Claude]]) uses a sniper rifle to give fire assistance and eliminate enemies in order for another character (Michael/[[8-Ball]]) to plant bomb(s) and sink a cargo ship.

title: The Merryweather Heist
text: *After the mission ends, the Submersible will always spawn in a small courtyard by the side of the warehouse in the [[Sandy Shores Airfield]] permanently. The player will need a Cargobob to take the submarine back to the [[water]] so it can be used.
